title: Italia Dance Music Radio - Whatever Turns You On

lines.l: Pulling me to you
I hear your echo in the sky so blue
It lifts me higher than I ever knew
Every heartbeat feels like destiny
A wave of energy surrounding me
I'm wide awake inside this symphony
Ready now for what I'm meant to be
You turn me on
Like the sunrise breaking through the stars
You carry me on
Where the world feels bright, pure and warm
You turn me on
Every moment makes me feel reborn
You turn me on
On and on and on
On and on and on
The colors shimmer as we start to rise
A glowing rhythm lighting up the skies
Your voice is calling like a paradise
It pulls me forward, opens up my eyes
The morning light was sliding on my skin
